# ReachX — Performance Marketing & Social Media Marketing Agency (SMMA)

> ReachX (https://reachex.io) is an elite performance marketing and social media marketing agency (SMMA) specializing in high-ROAS Meta advertising (Facebook & Instagram), Conversion API (CAPI) infrastructure, conversion funnel architecture, and multi-location franchise growth.

## Core Specializations
- **Meta Ads Specialist Agency**: Algorithmic campaign optimization, audience testing, server-side Meta CAPI tracking, creative testing, and scaling ad accounts past profitable spend thresholds.
- **Social Media Marketing Agency (SMMA)**: Full-funnel customer acquisition, qualified lead generation, retargeting, and pipeline velocity.
- **Franchise Expansion**: Proven deployment of hyper-targeted lead engines enabling 140+ franchised outlets across India (e.g., MahaChai, Pyramid).
- **High-Converting Creative & CRO**: Editorial-grade performance creatives, hooks, video assets, and conversion rate optimization.
